dedicated_ci.name: N3-W P5 M04 direct Relay datagram cache priming CI

repair.root_cause: A restart clears the volatile Relay datagram cache and successful Direct telemetry did not repopulate it.
head_behavior: Build Relay-form datagrams for the exact Direct canonical tuple.
Commit the Direct resend cache only after MQTT publish success.
Preserve the prior successful cache on Direct publish failure.
Do not send ESP-NOW or enqueue the Relay retry cache from Direct priming.
Commit the normal Relay resend cache only after retry-cache enqueue success.

pause_invariants: Keep PR #301 Draft and unmerged until separately authorized.
Do not replay the consumed M04 RESEND.
Perform no board, serial, Flash, reset, power, MQTT publish, path-control, or service mutation.
Keep M05 prohibited until a new M04 execution and closure pass.
